author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000957701
[ALPHA/BETA HYDROLASE DOMAIN-CONTAINING PROTEIN (PTHR12277)](http://www.pantherdb.org/panther/family.do?clsAccession=PTHR12277)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Human ABHD12 (Q8N2K0) and orthologs


* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue*** 
Erroneous source

Primary annotations to (HUMAN|HGNC=15868|UniProtKB=Q8N2K0) and (MOUSE|MGI=MGI=1923442|UniProtKB=Q99LR1) are currently to GO:0004622	
phosphatidylcholine lysophospholipase activity (note the label of this term was recently changed - see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30258)

I've disputed those annotations in P2GO, requesting they are changed to the new term GO:0120560 phosphatidylserine lysophospholipase activity

body: FYI - (HUMAN|HGNC=15868|UniProtKB=Q8N2K0) and (MOUSE|MGI=MGI=1923442|UniProtKB=Q99LR1) annotations have now been updated to GO:0120560 phosphatidylserine lysophospholipase activity

author: marcfeuermann
body: The term is too recent... I've removed the annotation to GO:0004622 but still have to wait for the new term to be available. With the new functionality of PAINT I will be able to create the primary annotation directly for propagation, so we will not have to wait months but it seems that the term itself is not yet available with PAINT.
